column1: # Every rename and deletion of a served docs page across the release tags, mapped to
# URL space: the historical URL universe scripts/validate_url_history.py validates
# against. A URL appears once per release-tag pair that renamed (R) or deleted (D) it;
# the validator reads the distinct old-url values and requires each to be served,
# Generated 2026-11-25 from this repository's git history: per consecutive-tag-pair
# `git diff --find-renames --name-status <a> <b> -- docs/ mkdocs.yml` over all release
# tags plus main, with pages mapped to URLs the way mkdocs serves them (docs_dir is
# docs/content in every era, use_directory_urls default: docs/content/X.md -> X/,
# index.md and README.md -> their directory's URL). Alias tags (v3, v3.0.0-beta) were
# dropped, dated betas ordered before v3.0.0, pure source moves (same URL) and
# non-page files skipped. 149 rows: 143 D, 6 R.
# Append rows when a release renames or deletes a page; never rewrite history rows.
